nieuw.titel: Reform a retreating screen to expose the enemy's flank
nieuw.tekst: If your screen survives and falls back in good order, use its free reform to turn it so the enemy's follow-up exposes a flank to your supporting unit. This can turn your next countercharge into a flank charge.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He shows Ellyrian Reavers falling back nine inches and pivoting so that Skeleton Chariots following up expose their flank to Silver Helms.

aanvullingen.waarom: He explains that fleeing bait can draw the enemy forward when no alternative charge target is available. A sacrificial screen can also leave the enemy exposed, whether it restrains or makes an overrun that falls short of the supporting unit.
aanvullingen.voorbeeld: He shows Ellyrian Reavers fleeing through supporting Silver Helms so the advancing chariots can be charged next turn. In another setup, the Reavers stand an inch in front of the chariots, with the Silver Helms far enough away that reaching them by overrun is unlikely but their own charge remains achievable.
aanvullingen.wanneerNiet: He warns that fleeing through the supporting unit causes a panic test and requires the fleeing unit to rally. In the sacrificial-screen setup, a high overrun could reach the support, and the supporting unit could roll too low for its charge.
aanvullingen.toelichting: Both demonstrations position expendable bait so that an enemy charging it becomes a target for a supporting unit's countercharge.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He identifies Feigned Flight as particularly useful on a screen that flees to set up a countercharge.
